versions.changelog:
Initial release of Ghost in the Droid.

- Control real Android and iOS devices with 62 automation tools via MCP server.
- Supports app launching, screen interaction (tap, swipe, type), screenshots, and UI tree parsing.
- Enables on-device inference (llama.cpp, MediaPipe, MLX) and batched flows.
- Includes emulator pool management (Docker+KVM) for Android.
- Compatible with ADB (Android) and WebDriverAgent (iOS); extensive setup and usage documentation provided.
